observations: Photo 0: an open pink hard case containing a 32-key melodica (pianica) with a white flexible mouth-tube, a rigid mouthpiece, and a hand strap; several keys have small coloured note-stickers.
Photo 1: the same pink case closed, showing an embossed 'YAMAHA' logo on the front; the case surface is dusty and has visible finger smudges and scuff marks.
Photo 2: a different, white/grey coloured case of the same melodica design lying next to an unrelated, worn, full-size electronic keyboard with yellowed keys and cracked key-tops.
The case colour in photo 2 does not match the pink case in photos 0 and 1, and a separate keyboard instrument appears in the background.
No serial number, model plate, or close-up of the reed/mouthpiece interior is visible in any photo.
A watermark 'AVANT-GARDE MUSIC / POSTED ON JIJI' overlays all three photos, consistent with a resold or stock listing rather than the seller's own fresh photos.

claims.claim: Like new, never repaired or opened
claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows a dusty, smudged, visibly used case, not consistent with 'like new'.
No video or audio clip of the reeds sounding; cannot confirm airtightness or key function from photos.
No receipt or warranty card shown in any photo.

claims.claim: Implied single item for sale ('a keyboard')
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows a different-coloured case and an unrelated full keyboard instrument, suggesting mixed or mismatched listing photos.

risks.risk: Reed or airway damage making the melodica unplayable despite visual appearance
risks.proof: A short video of someone blowing a few notes across the full key range
Close-up photo of the mouthpiece and hose connection points

risks.risk: Case colour mismatch and unrelated keyboard in photo 2 suggest photos may not all be of the actual item for sale
risks.proof: A fresh photo of the exact item with today's date or a handwritten note visible
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified identity, worst case condition

risks.risk: No serial/model plate visible to confirm authenticity of Yamaha branding
risks.proof: Close-up of any printed model/serial sticker near the mouthpiece or underside

proof_requests: A short video of the melodica being played across its full key range to confirm sound and airtightness
A clear photo of the exact item together with a handwritten note/date to resolve the case-colour mismatch
Close-up of any model/serial marking on the instrument or case
Photo of the receipt and warranty card mentioned in the listing
response.reason: The photos show inconsistent items (two different case colours and an unrelated keyboard), and the 'like new, never opened' claim is contradicted by visible wear, raising doubt about whether the photos truthfully represent a single item for sale.
